fields.display_title: This paper presented a novel theoretical framework to analyze some state-of-the-art self-supervised learning methods.  The authors proved that the weights are updated by a covariance operator that amplifies initial random selectivities that vary across data samples during training and explain how the good representations can be learned in this way. And the authors also analyze the reason why BYOL can work with no negative samples.
